en.title: Educate Girls - Data & Privacy Policy
en.introduction: Educate Girls is committed to protecting the privacy of our donors, volunteers, and website visitors. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal data in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP), 2023, while we work to advance girls' education across India.
en.general_purpose_description: We process personal data to process donations, manage volunteer registrations, send program updates, and improve our website experience.

data_processing_purposes.name: Donation Processing
data_processing_purposes.description: To process one-time and recurring donations, issue tax receipts (80G), and maintain donor records as required by law.
data_processing_purposes.retention_policy: Retained for 8 years post-transaction to comply with Income Tax Act record-keeping requirements for 80G receipts.

data_processing_purposes.name: Volunteer Registration & Management
data_processing_purposes.description: To register, verify, and coordinate volunteers supporting field and outreach programs.
data_processing_purposes.retention_policy: Retained for 3 years after last active engagement, then deleted unless re-consented.

data_processing_purposes.name: Newsletter & Program Updates
data_processing_purposes.description: To send email/SMS updates about programs, impact stories, and fundraising campaigns.
data_processing_purposes.retention_policy: Retained until consent is withdrawn (unsubscribe), with a 2-year inactivity backstop.

data_processing_purposes.name: Website Analytics & Improvement
data_processing_purposes.description: To understand website usage patterns and improve navigation and content for visitors.
data_processing_purposes.retention_policy: Anonymized/aggregated after 14 months per analytics provider defaults.

data_categories_details.name: Full Name
data_categories_details.description: Legal name of donor, volunteer, or visitor.

data_categories_details.name: Postal Address
data_categories_details.description: Mailing address for receipts and correspondence.

data_categories_details.name: PAN Card
data_categories_details.description: Required for donations eligible for 80G tax exemption above statutory thresholds.

data_categories_details.name: Volunteer Skills
data_categories_details.description: Self-declared skills and availability for volunteering.

data_categories_details.name: IP Address
data_categories_details.description: Network address captured for analytics and security.

data_categories_details.name: Device Identifier
data_categories_details.description: Anonymized device/browser identifier used for analytics.

en.security_measures: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, role-based access control, periodic access audits.
